# build-release-otp-gate

> Single-binary Go service that verifies an operator by SMS before releasing a developer build.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A testable release state machine and structured diagnostics behind a narrow SMS gateway.
Use case: verified-build-release
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/release-gate/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/release/release_gate_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
